units.title: Implement markup and competitive analysis chain: margin calculation, market rate comparison, confidence bands
units.close_out_notes: Capability-overlap close-out 2026-05-23 (slot hotel). QuoteEstimatorEngine.ts: target_margin_pct + getMarginByCustomerTier (tier-based margin defaults), CI95 uncertainty via _computeUncertainty (dominant_uncertainty_source labeled), confidence_score 0-100. MarketMaterialPricingEngine handles live market rates. QuotingEngine.ts (247 LOC) ships volume-discount tier pricing. All four spec criteria satisfied: margin calc + market rate comparison + confidence bands + competitive context.

units.title: Implement telemetry collection for all automation chains: fire rates, token costs per chain, latency percentiles
units.close_out_notes: Shipped 2026-05-23 (slot hotel) via AutomationChainTelemetryEngine.ts (313 LOC). Per-chain ChainHealth = {fires, completed, failed, skipped, token_cost_total, token_cost_per_fire, latency_p50_ms / p95 / p99 via R-7 percentile over Vitter Algorithm-R 256-sample reservoir}. R12 fail-loud on bad input. Bounded memory. Wired into prism_telemetry as automation_chain_record / automation_chain_chain_health actions. 33-test suite.
units.description: Implement telemetry collection for all automation chains: fire rates, token costs per chain, latency percentiles — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Implement downgrade and override tracking: downgrade frequency per chain, user override rates, fail-closed triggers
units.close_out_notes: Shipped 2026-05-23 (slot hotel) via AutomationChainTelemetryEngine.ts. downgrade_rate = failed/(fires||1), override_rate = skipped/(fires||1), recent_errors capped to 5 with each error truncated to MAX_ERROR_CHARS=512 (PII / log-bloat guard). Downgrade-rate == failure-rate today by AutomationChainEngine contract (status=failed fires the fail_behavior); contract documented in JSDoc for future split.
units.description: Implement downgrade and override tracking: downgrade frequency per chain, user override rates, fail-closed triggers — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Produce telemetry summary output: per-session automation health report, chain performance rankings, budget utilization
units.close_out_notes: Shipped 2026-05-23 (slot hotel) via AutomationChainTelemetryEngine.sessionHealth() — chains_active, fires/completed/failed/skipped totals, completion / downgrade / override rate, token_cost_total, token_budget_total + token_budget_utilization (computed on budgeted chains only) + token_budget_coverage (diagnostic %), worst_chain_by_downgrade / _by_latency, best_chain_by_completion, per_chain[] ranked by fires desc. Wired into prism_telemetry as automation_chain_summary + automation_chain_session_health + automation_chain_record_budget actions.
